summary: The StudentEOrientation is a user interface component that manages the student e-orientation process. It includes functionality for course management, retaking courses, generating completion certificates, and interacting with an external site for e-learning.
purpose: To facilitate and manage the electronic orientation process for students, providing options for course retakes and certificate generation.

workflows.name: Course Retake Workflow
steps: Check if course is completed and if retake is allowed
Execute retake logic and update interface

business_rules: Course retakes are allowed only if the course is completed and certain conditions are met.
A certificate of completion is available only when the student has completed the orientation.
validations: Check if UserSession is valid before allowing actions
Confirm the retake action with the user before proceeding
calculations: Comparison of course status and other date-related conditions for retake eligibility
conditions: Course status must be 'completed' to show retake button
PRDEndDate should be valid for displaying retake option
system_behavior: Display interface components based on user session and course completion status
Open external e-learning site for course access
exceptions: Actions are cancelled if UserSession is null
No retake option if PRDEndDate is invalid or course isn't fully completed
